description: This file defines the PHP class 'Translation' within the namespace 'Opencart.Catalog.Model.Design'. The class extends a base system class and provides a method 'getTranslations' to retrieve translation data from the database based on route, store ID, and language ID. The file contains class-level documentation and method implementation related to translation management in the OpenCart system.

classes.name: Translation
classes.description: A model class for handling translation data retrieval in the design module of the OpenCart catalog system.

methods.name: getTranslations
methods.description: Retrieves translation entries from the database matching the specified route, store ID, and language ID.
